notes.content:

You are not a hero. You are a contractor, managing a guild with blade and calculation. Experience the demo and immerse yourself in a world where morality has a price and survival is everything.

notes.title: Demo Update: New Localizations Added. Gameplay Mechanics Improved
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266666/4c83ea1d03676a2addc2ea1c0f9bdfdc68411593.jpg[/img]
Hello!

The demo version has received another update.
We’ve added new localizations and made several improvements to make the gameplay more comfortable and clear.

Full list of changes:
[list]
[*] Added translations for the following languages: German, French, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified), Turkish.
[*] Turn order of combat participants is now displayed in battles.
[*] Choice buttons in quests now show an icon of the attribute affecting party members' loyalty change.
[*] Generated quest titles now indicate their difficulty level.
[/list]

At this stage, we are making changes to the full version of the game as well as the playtest version. This includes improvements to the turn-based combat system.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180010/Blades_For_Hire_Demo/

You can always reach out to our team with any questions:
We invite you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/REsGgmh6Fq]Discord[/url] server.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings!

We're grateful for all the feedback we've received from players, as well as from those who shared their playthroughs and livestreams.

We've prepared the first round of fixes, and they are now available in the current demo version:

Changes:

[list]
[*] Selected mercenary tactic is now saved between battles. You won’t have to choose the same tactic over and over again.
[*] Resting mercenaries now recover health continuously, rather than just once per day.
[*] Increased the chance of generating a mage recruit each week.
[*] The starting quest has been moved to a neighboring town so that new players can immediately learn how to navigate the map.
[*] Tweaked the timing of loot distribution event after the "The Warehouse Heist" quest.
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of the final quest.
[/list]
Fixes:

[list]
[*] Dagger-wielding enemies can no longer attack from the back row while ignoring their front row allies (they can still ignore obstructing player characters, as originally intended).
[*] Fixed interface display issues on UltraWide monitors.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of available training options.
[*] Characters that leave due to low loyalty are now instantly removed from the Storage window.
[*] The temporary effect "Lacerations" now correctly reduces healing speed by 50%.
[*] Fixed an error caused by clicking through quest steps too quickly.
[*] Fixed an error caused by "Hymn of the Invincible" tactic.
[/list]

Very soon, we’ll launch playtests open to everyone, which will include all the current fixes. Based on the results of the playtests, we’ll make the final adjustments and begin preparing for release!

If you have any questions for the team, don’t hesitate to ask —
we’d love to hear from you on our [url=https://discord.gg/REsGgmh6Fq]Discord[/url] server.

notes.title: Blades For Hire — Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266666/9e055eab193f80b2a45170f3d77610e1efb44d93.jpg[/img]

Greetings, mercenaries!

We’re excited to announce that the [b]free demo[/b] of our dark tactical RPG Blades for Hire is available now on Steam — a game where loyalty has a price, and that price is gold.

And starting tomorrow, Blades for Hire will join the [b]Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Edition[/b] festival — stay tuned for updates, livestreams, and exclusive content on our Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180010/Blades_For_Hire_Demo/

[b]Blades for Hire[/b] is a tactical RPG that doesn’t care about your morals.
In a world no longer worth saving, you command a guild of mercenaries just trying to make a profit from what’s left. And today, you get a first look — [b]the free demo is available to everyone[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266666/123fc01fd2d19daae631a969f441eba287c7b5b9.gif[/img]

[h3][b]You're not the hero. You're the boss.[/b][/h3]
You don’t play a chosen one. You manage a struggling mercenary guild in a rotting fantasy world. Your crew? A mix of renegades, idealists, thieves, and cynics who follow you not out of loyalty — but because you pay them. On time. Or else.

[h3][b]No grand quest. Just dirty work.[/b][/h3]
There’s no prophecy or world-saving arc. Instead, you’ll face contracts filled with extortion, blackmail, massacres, and ruthless decisions. Your actions shape your reputation and unlock (or block) new opportunities. The Church may despise you — but the criminal underworld might welcome you with open arms.

[h3]What to expect in the demo:[/h3]
• First missions and early in-game choices
• Tactical combat with indirect control
• Guild economy and basic management
• A glimpse into the world and its brutal rules

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266666/a4d2894f5bb46f066adb19c2587780ed5c2a3c7f.png[/img]

[h3]What to expect in the full version:[/h3]
— [b]150+ contracts and missions:[/b]
From escorts and ambushes to betrayal, extortion, and moral gray areas.
— [b]Tactical combat with indirect control:[/b]
Set strategies and priorities — your mercs act on their own (and not always how you’d like).
— [b]Deep mercenary relationship system:[/b]
Every character is unique, with values, limits, and personalities. Bonds impact efficiency, loyalty, and story outcomes.
— [b]Guild economy system:[/b]
Salaries, equipment, hiring and firing, bribes, donations — everything has a cost.
— [b]Choices that shape the world and your reputation:[/b]
Your actions affect which factions you can work with — the Church, criminals, nobles, or outcasts. Your path determines your contracts.
— [b]No good or evil. Just consequences:[/b]
This is not a game of “right” decisions — it's about what's necessary, what's profitable, or just the least awful option.
— [b]High replayability:[/b]
Every run is different thanks to branching paths, dynamic events, and your crew’s unpredictable nature.

[h2]Wishlist, follow, and remember — there are no heroes here. Just contracts, cold steel, and the price you’re willing to pay.[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180000/Blades_For_Hire/

[h2]Got questions?[/h2]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/REsGgmh6Fq]Discord server[/url] to ask the developers directly and share feedback with the community.

notes.title: Introducing Blades for Hire!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266666/c43848f452d90eb9a4ea8cafecfed76caa40ac30.png[/img]

Greetings, dear players!

Let us introduce you to a new strategy game called [b]Blades for Hire[/b], where you will control a mercenary guild in a realistic fantasy setting.

Dive deep into the world where the protagonist, on the brink of survival, is forced to find questionable ways to earn money. Every day you will have to choose between following the dictates of your conscience or giving preference to pragmatism and profit. You will make these decisions through your Guild, and each mercenary will be an asset in your success.

A world of tactical battles, character development, and moral dilemmas awaits you in [b]Blades for Hire[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180000/Blades_For_Hire/

[h3]Create the legend of your guild and shape its future![/h3]

But let's take a look at the trailer first.
